description: Questions about RepoScout's own code. Run from the repo root: `reposcout index && reposcout eval retrieval evals/retrieval_self.json`. Expected entries are `path` or `path::Symbol`; a hit on any of them counts.

cases.question: How are code files split into chunks?
How are Python files parsed into functions, methods and classes?
How does hybrid search combine keyword results with vector results?
Where is reciprocal rank fusion implemented?
How does indexing skip files that have not changed since the last run?
Which folders and file types are ignored when indexing?
How is the GitHub webhook signature verified?
How are review comments posted on a pull request?
How is a unified diff parsed into files and hunks?
What happens when the model reports a line number that is not part of the diff?
How are hard-coded secrets and API keys detected?
How are failed requests to the LLM retried?
How is JSON extracted from the model's reply?
How are duplicate review findings merged?
How does the hashing embedder turn text into vectors without a model?
Where are camelCase identifiers split into words?
Which API endpoint answers a question about the code?
What stops an index built with one embedding model being searched with another?
How does the review command decide its exit code for CI?
How are review results rendered as markdown?
